corrections.title: Downgrade Baylan Skoll vs Pirate King Hondo 5v5 counter (#141)
corrections.rationale: Owner reports repeated firsthand 5v5 GAC losses using Baylan Skoll against Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka, consistently defeating zero enemy units. Approved: downgrade the unreliable counter to C, keep the record, and stop it being presented as dependable. S / 63 becomes C / 55 (the lowest existing 5v5 score meaning); the existing tier-first ordering then ranks it behind every other Hondo counter. Other Hondo counters, 3v3 and fleet data are unchanged.

evidence.supports: Repeated firsthand 5v5 losses with Baylan Skoll against Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka, consistently defeating zero enemy units; downgrade to C at most approved.

provenance.conditions: 5v5 only, Baylan Skoll versus Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka. Defending lineup, relics, mods and datacrons were not recorded.
provenance.confidence: Low-to-medium: repeated firsthand reports with a consistent outcome, but no recorded sample size or win rate.
provenance.limitations: No sample size, win rate or banners recorded. C / 55 is a conservative planning value, not a measurement. Baylan remains a selectable last-resort option when it is the only owned answer.

affectedReferences.effect: BAYLAN row S / 63 becomes C / 55 with an unreliability note; row order and the CERE, SLKR, LEIA and JMK rows unchanged.
none - checked: global definition and other defences' Baylan rows unchanged.

runtimeImpact.counters: Only the Baylan row versus Pirate King Hondo changes.

counters.notes: Provisional: field the full five - Leia Organa (GL, leader), R2-D2, Captain Drogan, Mon Mothma, C-3PO. One owner-observed full victory; 62 is an owner-approved planning estimate for a successful full-squad first-attempt clear, not measured banners or an average. Attacker survival/damage details were not recorded; no established win rate or datacron independence.

Provisional, conditional: field the full five - Jedi Master Kenobi (leader), Ahsoka Tano (Snips, not GL), Commander Ahsoka Tano (CAT), General Kenobi, Wat Tambor. Owner reports possible full wins and a possible attack loss after defeating three defenders, leaving a cleanup opportunity. Three defender defeats are not guaranteed; no dependable setup/cleanup pairing is established. 58 is an owner-approved planning estimate for a successful full-squad first-attempt clear, not measured banners or an average; actual attacker survivors were not recorded. A loss is not a victory or a 58-banner result.

Retained for history; prefer the other Hondo counters.
